artifacts.stop_loss: request one clarification when the seed has no discernible dramatic element

validation: candidate has protagonist, desire, opposition, stakes, and change
artifacts.stop_loss: stop after two candidate regeneration rounds without new constraints

validation: genre conventions and obligations are explicit
artifacts.stop_loss: return to candidates when premise and genre obligations materially conflict
escalate after three failed honesty repairs

validation: inner, personal, and extra-personal pressures exist
artifacts.stop_loss: merge or defer characters after two unresolved overlap audits

validation: causal turning points, crisis, climax, and resolution cohere
artifacts.stop_loss: return to premise when two spine repairs cannot produce a causal climax

validation: sequences escalate and end in meaningful turns
artifacts.stop_loss: return to spine after two act designs preserve the same structural gap

validation: each scene has objective, conflict, gap, turn, value change, and consequence
artifacts.stop_loss: return gapless scenes to act design after one focused repair

validation: beats form a causal dramatic unit and open consequential gaps
artifacts.stop_loss: return to scene contract when beat repair cannot create a value turn

validation: voice, POV, specificity, subtext, exposition, and continuity checks pass
artifacts.stop_loss: apply story-stop-loss after the configured scene revision cap

validation: chapter boundaries preserve escalation, viewpoint, promise, and rhythm
artifacts.stop_loss: revert chapter regrouping when two passes reduce structural clarity

validation: critic dimensions cite evidence and separate blocking from advisory findings
artifacts.stop_loss: stop when critics repeat findings without new evidence

validation: passes are separated by purpose and changes are traceable
artifacts.stop_loss: stop after three unsuccessful repairs of the same root finding

validation: continuity, privacy, attribution, and formatting checks pass
artifacts.stop_loss: publication remains blocked while any privacy or continuity P0/P1 issue exists

validation: manifest, source versions, checksums, and approval record are present
artifacts.stop_loss: never publish or disclose without explicit human approval
